newsitem.title: USA: US Army Corps/Engineers shuts another river lock.
newsitem.headline: US Army Corps/Engineers shuts another river lock.

text.p: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers said it has now shut down Lock and Dam 6 near Trempealeau, Wis. on the upper Mississippi River due to high water.
"That lock closed early this morning," said Ken Gardner, public affairs officer, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, St Paul, Minn.
So far, nine locks have been closed from upper and lower St Anthony Falls, Minn., and southward to Lock and Dam 6 at Trempealeau, Corps officials said.
Gardner said he did not know when the locks would be reopened.
"In 1969, we had similar river levels and 12 locks were closed for two weeks in April during the same time frame as this year," he said.
The Corps said it expected to close Lock and Dam 8 (Genoa, Wis.) on April 14, Lock and Dam No. 9 (at Eastman, Wis.) on April 15 and Lock and Dam No. 10 (Guttenberg, Iowa) on April 16.
The Coast Guard late Wednesday closed navigation between Minneapolis and Guttenberg but is allowing some barge movement on a case by case basis.
